name: Riverbend Tower
title: Riverbend Tower
summary: An Empyrean stone tower along the River Prosper where Riverbend portals drop; a Renegade Stronghold portal lies by the river 130 m south-east. In the kit: a 19 m three-storey brick-and-stone tower with a pitched roof (top z 43.4) on a grassy terrace at z 24, a forested slope falling east to the river (z 4) and the stronghold portal at the water's edge.

landmarks.name: River Prosper
landmarks.note: Running water east of the forested slope.

site.name: Riverbend Tower
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer riverbend (Riverbend portal drop point 21 m east of the tower, z 24).

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up 38 m west of the Empyrean stone tower with the afternoon sun behind the lens until the River Prosper shows beyond the trees; keep 4 m from every crown.
shots.notes: Signature boom rise: 38 m due west of the Empyrean stone tower, from 2 m to 34 m straight up (z 26 -> 58, 15 m above the roof ridge at 43.4) with the afternoon sun (0.63) behind the lens: the tower's sunlit west face slides down until its roof clears and the River Prosper valley shows beyond the forested east slope.
